notes.title: 🌅 It Was Beautiful Launches April 23 – With a Special Release Discount!
notes.notes:
Dear Deep Sea Travelers,

It Was Beautiful is launching on April 23 — and we’re beyond excited to finally share this emotional story with you. 💙

To celebrate the release, we're offering a special launch discount that will be available not just on release day, but for several days after! 🎉 It’s the perfect time to dive in and experience the journey at a reduced price.

In It Was Beautiful, you’ll follow a small fish and its father on a heartfelt journey toward a legendary sunset. 🐟✨ Discover atmospheric underwater worlds, solve meaningful puzzles, and explore a story that stays with you long after the credits roll.

🔹 Emotional adventure about hope and acceptance
🔹 Stunning underwater environments
🔹 A bond between parent and child
🔹 Exploration and beautiful discoveries

💫 Add the game to your WISHLIST to get notified at launch. Thank you for being part of this journey — we’ll see you beneath the surface very soon. 🌌

With love,
The It Was Beautiful Team
